response.rationale: Several independent T1 meta-analyses (Cepeda 2006, Kim 2022, Latimier 2021) plus T2 to T4 field and longitudinal studies (Bahrick 1993, Kornell 2009, Rawson 2013) consistently show spaced practice beats massed practice for long-term retention, and the optimal gap scales with the retention interval; the evidence list has some duplicate entries, and the 5 negative items weren't shown, so I can't weigh them.
